philosophy: new mechanisms only (owner anti-fixation rules, 25 Oct 2026): cash-conversion inflection (SEC filing-date event), spin-offs after index selling (count first), neglected-then-noticed (outside reviewer, as written)
preRegistered: squad22-core.mjs header (25 Oct 2026, before any run) + data/strategy-library.json SQ22-*
standard: both halves (before / from 2024-01-01): > 0 after 0.8% and 1.2%, better than the average liquid stock over the same sessions, better than the same stock on its other days, > 0 without its 2 best, 20+ trades and 3+ blocks, block t >= 2.5, return per year of capital above SPY -> TRADABLE SMALL; block t >= 4.07 -> PROVEN; plus each rule's own extra yardstick (CASHCONV: V15 same sessions; NEGLECTED: same-day quiet crashed stocks). Every gross return capped at +300% (AUD-1).

notRun.name: First-ever SC 13D by the filer (activist ownership disclosure), clean supply, hold 63, stop 15%
notRun.status: not run: duplicate of ANOM-13D (rejected 23 Oct 2026)
notRun.why: ANOM-13D (original SC 13D, next open, hold 63) was REJECTED in both halves (edge -3.9% / -3.4% a trade). A first-ever 13D is in practice the same original filing; adding liquidity, supply filters and a stop makes a variant of a failed rule, which the owner's anti-fixation rules (25 Oct 2026) forbid. The 13G (passive) information version is not run either.

notRun.name: Buyback + insider buying + cash-rich (owner reviewer)
notRun.why: overlaps C-INSQ1 (insider cluster + cash-rich quality, queued for Agent C). Its "NOT SIC 35/36/38" clause comes from V15's own past losses (fitted to the result) and must not be used.
